world.title: The Lantern Sea
world.subtitle: An archipelago lit by captive stars
world.description: Across a black ocean, island-cities survive by tending fragments of fallen starlight.

articles.title: Glasswake Harbor
articles.content:
[h2]A City on Moving Water[/h2]
Glasswake Harbor is built upon seven linked hull-islands whose glass keels sing when storms approach. The harbor survives by the light of {{article:lanterns|starfall lanterns}} tended from the western beacon.

Its elected tidekeeper, {{article:mara|Mara Vey}}, enforces the promises recorded in {{article:compact|the Lantern Compact}}.

articles.title: Mara Vey, Keeper of Tides
articles.content:
[h2]Keeper of Tides[/h2]
Mara Vey listens to the harmonics beneath {{article:harbor|Glasswake Harbor}} and predicts when its seven hull-islands must separate. She carries the brass seal of {{article:compact|the Lantern Compact}} and refuses to let any single house own the beacon.

articles.title: The Lantern Compact
articles.content:
[h2]The Founding Promise[/h2]
The Compact declares that no flame fallen from the sky may belong to one person. It binds {{article:harbor|Glasswake Harbor}} to shelter any vessel whose guiding light has failed and charges {{article:mara|the Keeper of Tides}} with preserving the beacon.

articles.title: Starfall Lanterns
articles.content:
[h2]Bottled Constellations[/h2]
Starfall lanterns are cages of tideglass holding sparks recovered after celestial storms. They illuminate {{article:harbor|Glasswake Harbor}}, but each burns a little colder whenever someone breaks an oath sworn under its light. The oldest rules governing them appear in {{article:compact|the Lantern Compact}}.

homepage.homepageContent1:
[h1]Welcome to the Lantern Sea[/h1]
Begin in {{article:harbor|Glasswake Harbor}}, meet {{article:mara|its Keeper of Tides}}, and discover why {{article:lanterns|bottled stars}} answer to {{article:compact|an ancient promise}}.
